Theme

Latin word

sēdēs

sēdēs, sēdis f.

noun, third declension, with an adjective or a gerundive

an agency, an office: sēdēs periēgētica, a travel agency; with a genitive, the seat of an activity: a centre, an office; seat, headquarters (of a business); seat; a home, a place to live (of a people)

In this lexicon

  • agency

    the recommended word · modern · Traupman 219: sēdēs periēgētica, travel agency; M-O s.v. news agency: sēdēs nūntiīs dīvulgandīs (Egger)

  • centre

    the recommended word · modern · M-O s.v. tourist office, information office, visitors’ center: sēdēs nūntiātiōnum, citing Egger; M-O s.v. office: officiōrum sēdēs, citing Egger

  • headquarters

    also used · classical · Traupman 326

  • seat

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 212, 218

  • settlement

    also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.31.14: aliud domicilium, aliās sēdēs
